goal: Policy as code gate: organisational rules written as code and checked on every change.
use: Policy as code gate: organisational rules written as code and checked on every change. Use when a team writes or changes rules for infrastructure or deployments.

steps.note: List the policies. Each rule with its purpose and owner.
Confirm each policy is code, versioned and tested.
Set the rule. A change that breaks a policy is blocked with a clear message.
Check drift. Flag policies that exist only as documents.
Report. Each policy, its enforcement point and any gap.
